messages:
Priya R: Heads-up — MediaChain wants a BYO-KMS POC. Requirements: HSM-backed CMKs, sign latency target <15ms, 99.95% business-hrs SLA, and external pen-test 2024-11-18. They also want rotation without app downtime. Can we scope?
Ethan L: Do they want Redwood Private in their VPC or Dedicated with our HSM proxy?
Priya R: They prefer Private but could accept Dedicated if it guarantees latency. Cross-region DR required.
Connor (Solutions): For <15ms we need HSM local to runtime. Options: deploy Redwood Private in their VPC with their CloudHSM, or Dedicated + HSM proxy colocated in same AZ. On-prem over tunnel will likely break <15ms.
Priya R: They estimated bursts up to 300 sign ops/s.
Connor (Solutions): Recommend ephemeral CEKs + wrapping to reduce HSM QPS ~10x and short in-memory cache of unwrapped CEKs.
InfraBot: Preflight ticket created: POC-MEDIA-BYO-2024. Items: network test, perf baseline, sec-qa, SOW.
Priya R: Pricing ask: delta Dedicated+proxy vs Private (pass-through)? Need quick ballpark for procurement.
Connor (Solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated+proxy with reserved GPUs ~$15k/mo. Private with BYO-HSM ~ $22k/mo first year (includes setup). Exact depends on GPU tier and egress.
LegalOps: Send sec-qa (https://redwood.internal/sec-qa) and request HSM vendor attestation (FIPS + vendor POA). Note export-control review.
Ethan L: Rotation: we can offer overlap key rollout: provision next key, serve both for overlap, then retire old. That supports zero-app-change if SDK tolerates dual-key fetch; else ephemeral CEKs avoid per-op unwraps.
Priya R: Timeline constraint — final config by 2024-10-28 for pen-test prep. Can we meet?
Connor (Solutions): Tight but doable: kickoff 10/08, network test by 10/12, provision 10/13-10/20, perf 10/21-10/24, freeze 10/28. I'll draft SOW and risk item for on-prem BYO.
